name: add-input-validation
prompt: In src/cart.js the function addItem(cart, item) accepts anything. Add validation: sku is a non-empty string, qty is an integer greater than 0, price is a finite number not less than 0. On a violation throw a TypeError and name the field (sku, qty or price) in the message. Valid items must still be added as before. Add tests for the errors in test/cart.test.js. Verify with: npm test.
